DEATHKNIGHT_FROST:
Use Power Infusion on the Frost Deathknight when:

  • They are actively using Pillar of Frost, or if they do not have Pillar of Frost talented.
  • They are specced into Obliteration, or using Breath of Sindragosa while its buff is active, or if they have neither Obliteration nor Breath of Sindragosa talented.
DEATHKNIGHT_UNHOLY:
Use Power Infusion on the Unholy Deathknight when:

  • There are active enemies during a single-target phase or when enemies will persist (via cooldown planning or persistent adds).
  • Summon Gargoyle is active and has ≤22 seconds remaining OR (if not using Gargoyle) Army of the Dead is active with either:
    • An active Raise Abomination pet with <18 seconds remaining, OR
    • Active Army Ghouls with ≤18 seconds remaining
  • Dark Transformation is active (if not using Gargoyle or Army of the Dead talents).
  • Gargoyle isn’t active and the next Summon Gargoyle cooldown won’t align with Power Infusion’s duration.
  • There are ≥3 active enemies while Dark Transformation is active OR Death and Decay is affecting the area.
DEMONHUNTER_HAVOC:
Use Power Infusion on the Havoc Demonhunter when:

  • They activate Metamorphosis, as this synergizes with their primary damage window.
  • The encounter will end in 20 seconds or less to maximize the cooldown’s full duration.
DRUID_BALANCE:
Use Power Infusion on the Balance Druid when:

  • Their Celestial Alignment or Incarnation: Chosen of Elune is active to amplify their primary damage window.
  • They are casting Convoke the Spirits during a critical phase to maximize burst damage output.
  • They have activated Force of Nature alongside other cooldowns for stacked burst potential.
DRUID_FERAL:
Use Power Infusion on the Feral Druid when:

  • The Feral Druid has Berserk active during their rotation.
  • The Feral Druid does not have the Heart of the Lion talent selected.
EVOKER_DEVASTATION:
Use Power Infusion on the Devastation Evoker when:

  • Dragonrage is active and one of these conditions is met: Shattering Star is available (off cooldown), the target has the Shattering Star debuff, or there are 2+ active enemies.
  • The encounter will end within 35 seconds, regardless of other conditions.
HUNTER_MARKSMANSHIP:
Use Power Infusion on the Marksmanship Hunter when:

  • The hunter’s Trueshot buff has more than 12 seconds remaining, ensuring alignment with their major damage window.
  • The encounter will end within 13 seconds, allowing a final use of Power Infusion before combat concludes.
HUNTER_SURVIVAL:
Use Power Infusion on the Survival Hunter when:

  • The Hunter's Coordinated Assault is currently active.
  • They do not have Coordinated Assault talented and have activated Spearhead (cooldown is active).
  • They do not have either Coordinated Assault or Spearhead talented.
MAGE_ARCANE:
Use Power Infusion on the Arcane Mage when:

  • The mage does not have Spymaster's Web equipped and has just cast Arcane Surge.
  • The mage has Spymaster's Web equipped and has just cast Evocation.
MAGE_FIRE:
Use Power Infusion on the Fire Mage when:

  • Their Combustion is about to be cast and requires pre-casting support.
  • Their Combustion is active and has more than 7 seconds remaining.
  • The encounter will end within 20 seconds, ensuring maximum benefit during the final phase.
MAGE_FROST:
Use Power Infusion on the Frost Mage when:

  • Power Infusion is not currently active on them and their major cooldowns (such as Icy Veins) are ready or active.
MONK_WINDWALKER:
Use Power Infusion on the Windwalker Monk when:

  • Xuen the White Tiger is active and one of the following is true:
  • Bloodlust is not active, ensuring no overlap with haste buffs,
  • Bloodlust is active and Strike of the Windlord is nearly off cooldown (to align burst phases).
PALADIN_RETRIBUTION:
Use Power Infusion on the Retribution Paladin when:

  • the Paladin has an active Avenging Wrath buff
  • the Paladin has an active Crusade buff
  • the target is affected by the Execution Sentence debuff
PRIEST_SHADOW:
Use Power Infusion on the Shadow Priest when:

  • Voidform is active and Power Infusion is not.
  • Dark Ascension is active and Power Infusion is not.
  • The Shadow Priest has the TWW 4-piece set bonus active and Power Infusion is not.
ROGUE_ASSASSINATION:
Use Power Infusion on the Assassination Rogue when:

  • Their Deathmark bleed effect is active on the target, maximizing damage amplification during this high-impact window.
ROGUE_SUBTLETY:
Use Power Infusion on the Subtlety Rogue when:

  • The Rogue has Shadow Dance active to amplify their burst damage phase.
SHAMAN_ELEMENTAL:
Use Power Infusion on the Elemental Shaman when:

  • They have Ascendance active, maximizing their burst window, or
  • Their Ascendance cooldown has over 30 seconds remaining, ensuring no overlap between cooldown phases
SHAMAN_ENHANCEMENT:
Use Power Infusion on the Enhancement Shaman when:

  • Ascendance, Feral Spirit, or Doom Winds are active during their burst phase.
  • The final 20 seconds of a 2-minute encounter window (to maximize uptime before combat ends).
  • Their major offensive cooldowns won’t be available again within the next 120 seconds.
  • They haven’t selected Ascendance, Feral Spirit, or Doom Winds talents (use on cooldown by default).
WARLOCK_AFFLICTION:
Use Power Infusion on the Affliction Warlock when:

  • The warlock has activated major cooldowns (typically during Summon Darkglare windows or alongside Soul Rot) to maximize their damage amplification during critical burst phases.
WARLOCK_DESTRUCTION:
Use Power Infusion on the Destruction Warlock when:

  • The warlock’s Summon Infernal is active during its damage window.
  • The warlock does not have the Summon Infernal talent selected.
  • The encounter’s remaining duration is shorter than the cooldown of Summon Infernal plus 15 seconds, ensuring a final use of Power Infusion before the fight ends.
WARRIOR_ARMS: Use Power Infusion on the Arms Warrior when:
WARRIOR_FURY:
Use Power Infusion on the Fury Warrior when:

  • The target is in the execute phase (below 20% health) and the Fury Warrior has Avatar active.
  • The encounter is within the final 25 seconds of its duration.
